notes: Assumptions that change the number: kneading flour and the oiled bowl not counted; whole glaze (2 tbsp sugar) eaten; 20 buns from ~1.34 kg baked (~67 g each). Sanity check: Woolworths mosbolletjie (FatSecret ZA) is 278 kcal / 100 g, about 186 kcal for a 67 g bun; ours is 317 kcal / 100 g and 210 kcal a bun, ~13 % higher because this dough is richer in butter and sugar.
